source: Read-only snapshots of existing operator-produced ring diagnosis; no serving work launched by this task.

first_run.limitation: First full binaries were truncated on repeat boot. First-run history outside retained first/tail windows relies on the saved comparison aggregate.

record_semantics: These are last host-prepared records, written after compact_batch and before GPU reallocation, query_start_loc construction and eventual forward launch. Padded extent is recorded; CUDA graph mode, enqueue and completion are not. An earlier asynchronous error could surface before the final prepared forward enqueues. The records therefore do not prove that the divergent final layout executed, identify the failing GPU step, or capture confidence vectors, device receive-slot contents, target/drafter identity or the first bad tensor.
